notes.title: Update to beta 1.0 preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to the beta 1.0 preview !

This update contain :

- New skins for enemies.
- AI behaviors improvement ++
- AI Balancing
- AI Animation improvement and physical animation
- AI Melee fight
- Drivable explosive drone gadget
- Throwable knife weapon
- One new map ( still in dev... ) and abandonned building remake.
- Leaderboard system for rush mode
- Tutorial
- New menu
- Many bug fixes

And few other little things...

I Hope you'll enjoy !
Have Fun !
